limitations: Separate-process Electron companion is a controlled external app, not coverage of arbitrary third-party apps.
Injected Alt+Tab is not a physical-keyboard acceptance test.
Installed Obsidian archive runs in test Electron; installed-launcher equivalence is unproven.
Phase 2 controls are unsupported by the pinned public provider; source builds not verified.
get-windows filters some windows silently; a successful inventory is not proof of complete coverage.
Direct upstream N-API loading tests binary compatibility, not the ESM wrapper or production packaging.
